in_arabic.name: إوميما
in_arabic.long_meaning: إِسْمُ مُناسِبٍ لِلقَائِدَةِ الأُولى، وَهِيَ الأُمُّ المُؤَثّرةُ، وَمِنَ اللُّطَفِ، وَالتَفَرُّعُ مُؤَثّمٌ فِي الارْتَفَاعِ وَالأَخذاءِ، وَكَمالُ الإِنسانِيَّةِ وَالأَدَبِ، وَالإِسْمُ إِحاطَةٌ بِالخَلقِ، وَالتَفَرُّعُ نِزاعٌ بِمَنَزِلَتِهِ، وَأَحَقُّ الأَسماءِ بِالنَفسِ، وَأَبَرُّها بِالخَلقِ، وَأَقَرُّها بِاللَهِ

in_urdu.name: اُمیما
in_urdu.long_meaning: اُمیما ایک مناسب نام ہے جسے پہلا نام دیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام اُم مؤثّرة کی وجہ سے ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے نعمہ ہے۔ یہ نام اللطیفہ اور تفرع میں بھی شاندار ہے۔ یہ نام انسان کی کامل ہے اور آدب میں بھی بہترین ہے۔ یہ نام خالق کی حقیقی اور آخرت کے لحاظ سے آخرت کے لیے بھی بہترین ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उमायिम

in_pashto.name: اُمیما
in_pashto.long_meaning: اُمیما یوې پښې کښې دغه پهلی نوم دی چې د کړلو پر ځای کېږي. دا نوم یو مامور نوم دی چې په لچیلو او تفرع کې د هغے د ځایګی دښمن دی. دا نوم د انسان د پورتنۍ حیکلې د لچیلو په ډول دی. دا نوم دا ده چې د انسان د پورتنۍ حیکلې په ډول دی او په دی کې د انسان په شان دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name Umaima holds a profound cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is rooted in the virtue of being a source of comfort and support for believers. In Arabic, 'Umaima' derives from 'Umm Al-Mu'minin', which is a title given to certain women in the Quran who provided unwavering support and care to their Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the early Muslim community. Being a name that honors these esteemed women, Umaima has become a cherished name in many Islamic communities, symbolizing the importance of kindness, compassion, and support within the context of faith and family.
data.spiritual_significance: Umaima is a name that carries a deep spiritual significance for Muslims, as it reflects the theoretical and practical aspects of Islamic teachings. The practical significance of Umaima lies in the concept of compassion and comfort, which is an essential part of the Islamic way of life. As Muslims, we are encouraged to offer comfort and support to those in need, and to serve as sources of hope and encouragement for our loved ones and fellow believers. The theoretical significance of Umaima, on the other hand, lies in the idea that Allah (swt) is the ultimate source of comfort and support for His believers. As stated in the Quran, "And We have sent you [O Muhammad] to comfort the distressed souls, and with a response to the believers: when they hear what has been revealed to them or a mention of Allah and their faith is confirmed" (Quran 9:125). Therefore, bearing the name Umaima is a reminder of the spiritual responsibility that comes with being a supportive and compassionate individual, and a reminder that ultimately, Allah is the one who provides comfort and support to us in times of need.
